s02104.summary: Four teens stand in the dark silo bickering about staying until midnight.
A scraping noise above stops them; Devaki logs it on camera.
Silence falls; Magpie touches the ladder and the group waits nervously.
Thaddeus spots a pale shape high on the wall and they argue what it is.
They back toward the door; Devaki trips and drops the camcorder.
The light reveals the shape crouching and watching; Thaddeus yells run and they scatter.

s00118.summary: In the quiet apothecary the constable greets Ezekiel and declines tea.
Hendrick mentions a death on Pearl Street after a cough draught.
Hendrick ties the draught to the shop; Ezekiel denies making poisons.
The widow announces she mixed the draught that killed her husband.
She offers her wrists; Hendrick declines and asks why, and she begins her story.

s02453.summary: Ottoline keys SOS for hours as Percival and the captain wait anxiously.
A faint voice comes through the headphones; Ottoline realizes someone answers.
Carpathia promises rescue in four hours and the room erupts in relief.
Ottoline steadily taps the reply and the room finally falls still.

s00444.summary: On the roof Mina asks Hollis whether he really likes Priscilla.
Jasper reveals their dad sold the boat and that Mina cried.
Mina dares Hollis to jump, then to tell Priscilla the truth.
Hollis grins, finishes the soda and accepts the dare.

s00613.summary: In the swaying dining car Quinn serves Vera and they exchange a knowing look.
Dmitri slips a hand under the table; the car lurches and a glass shatters.
Quinn vanishes as Dmitri and Lennox draw guns on each other.
Vera stands between the gunmen and refuses to move.
Lennox fires, Vera falls, and the candle goes out.

s00790.summary: Cordelia, her client and a bailiff ride silently until the elevator stalls.
Deshawn radios dispatch; Cordelia frets about her verdict at ten.
Tobias catches her eye in the mirror and admits he lied.
Cordelia reveals she has known since Tuesday from the lab report.
She explains she stayed because everyone deserves a defense.
The car drops; Cordelia steadies Tobias and orders him to stay silent.
The doors open and Cordelia steps out first.

s01478.summary: The habitat crew plays cards and Tamsin and Piotr trade jabs.
A groan passes through the hull; Piotr dismisses it as sediment.
Topside reports weather and the lift schedule; Voss-Liang reports all quiet.
Voss-Liang notes no alarms; superstitious Piotr says the habitat listens.
The groan returns closer; Tamsin sees the silt is not settling.
All three stare at a rising black mass outside the viewport.
Topside warns of a seismic spike as the lights flicker and the hull shrieks.

s02395.summary: Cross questions the young man about three lamps lit on a night alone.
Cross calls him Penhallow and says his ignorance is a lie.
He reveals he is Tobias, the keeper's nephew who arrived Tuesday.
Cross asks where the uncle is; Tobias says on the rocks watching for ships.
Tobias explains the third lamp is for those who never return; Cross asks for everything.

s00473.summary: Wen slowly makes change for a tense Prakash with a sleeping toddler.
The barracks call asking about a grey Corolla; Wen sizes up Prakash.
Wen tells the police caller it is a quiet night and hangs up.
Wen points Prakash to the unpatrolled service road and returns to her book.

s00994.summary: Augustin copies condemned names into a ledger among the skulls.
A footstep; cloaked Celestine emerges claiming to be a friend of the dead.
Celestine says she is the sister of someone on his list.
Augustin asserts his authority; Celestine calls him a clerk with a candle.
Augustin threatens arrest; she dares him, noting the guards are drunk above.
She names her brother Pierre and insists Augustin holds the pen.
Augustin finds Pierre Duval's entry, condemned for a pamphlet.
He tears out the page, hands it over and offers an escape carriage.

s01956.summary: At dawn Marisol feeds the rooftop pigeons.
Eli climbs up with the injured pigeon and they bicker over its name.
The hatch traps Eli, the pigeon escapes, Marisol catches it as Eli falls.
Marisol cradles the cooing bird and smiles.

s00333.summary: In the eerie workshop Mina hears something and Lola says the horses watch her.
A horse swings and another turns its head; Teddy tells Mina to back up.
The lantern gutters and all the horses crash down as the carousel lurches alive.

s00373_0.summary: Dot describes her lost green hat with a bird to Barnaby.
A stranger appears behind her wearing the exact hat and tips it.
The stranger bolts; Barnaby vaults the counter and Dot swings her purse.

s01135.summary: Nadia climbs the stairwell with groceries; the timer light clicks off and on.
Nadia finds her neighbor Isaac standing motionless and silent above her.
Isaac turns with blank eyes and advances, whispering not to turn off the light.
The light dies and a wet breath touches her ear in the dark.
Mr. Okoro flips the switch and asks why they stand in the dark.
Isaac wakes bewildered, apologizes for sleepwalking and goes back upstairs.
Shaken, Nadia insists she is fine and hurries up the stairs.

s00208.summary: Hannelore leads the muddy trek and promises a stop at the next clearing.
Marisol cracks a stalk; Hannelore warns silence means something is listening.
They stop and hear a distant rustle that is not the wind.
Conflicting directions send Marisol the wrong way and the three tangle.
Thabo radios that they are lost but gets only static.
They agree to keep moving while the rustle keeps pace behind them.

s02220.summary: A hooded stranger walks up to the whalebone bridge where Brannoch counts coins.
Brannoch collects the toll, bites a coin and asks for a name.
The stranger lowers her hood and gives her name, Tavi, bound for the salt towns.
Ilsewyn shouts from below about the slipped rope and bickers with Brannoch.
Brannoch mentions his sister has been tired since their mother died.
Tavi asks if the ribs sing; the siblings argue sings versus whistles.
Tavi crosses the bridge as Brannoch warns her about the loose rib.

s00413.summary: Morwenna and old Ivar stand at the ice cave mouth knowing something waits inside.
A huge note thrums from within; Ivar says it knows her.
A giant slit eye opens in the dark and regards them.
Morwenna raises her spear; Ivar wrestles it away, forbidding weapons.
The eye blinks, the wind dies, and Morwenna slowly kneels.

s00860.summary: Marta brings Gideon's things to the kiln shed; he refuses to turn around.
Marta lays out his belongings carefully; they spar over the coat.
Gideon stands; a mug cracks in the kiln and they note it.
Gideon picks up their old beach photo and they speak in unison.
Marta covers her face and asks him to give her a minute.
Gideon sets the photo down and kneels to wait by the kiln.
Marta moves her stool beside him and offers to stay until a mug cracks.

s00781.summary: Hiding in the car wash, Nadia plays her recorded memos about the package.
The memos reveal she was followed and that they know the car wash.
Nadia checks door, bolt and window and freezes at a distant clank.
A fourth memo plays that she never recorded, dated tomorrow.
The recorded voice gently says it is only a hard drive and to walk away.
She opens the duffel to find a drive and a sorry note, and laughs.
Nadia takes the drive, deletes the memo, starts memo five and leaves.

s00211.summary: Detective Marisol waits by the casket in the hushed viewing room.
Leopold asks for privacy; Philomena insists her sister was unwell.
Marisol announces the lab found poison; Caleb drops a cufflink.
Philomena coolly asks who; Marisol says someone with access to the tea.
Caleb edges toward the exit and Marisol orders him to stay.
Marisol questions Philomena, who admits she bought and poured the tea.
Marisol ends questioning for tonight and Philomena walks out.
Alone, Marisol lifts the casket lid and looks at something inside.

s00143.summary: At a near-empty meeting the mayor announces the ferry will stop.
Tillie suggests petitions and prayer; the others shoot her down.
Gwendolyn says she fought for it; Barnabas tells her to fight harder.
The stranger introduces himself as Irving Tse from regional transit.
Irving lays out the costs and tiny ridership; Dot's quip draws tired laughter.
Irving offers a year's reprieve if the town raises forty thousand.
Dot offers her knitted scarf as a starting bid and wallets come out.

s00185.summary: On the tilting trawler Imelda counts her crew as they wait.
The crew wryly trades remarks about the raft, dead pump and saucepan.
Imelda gives her niece Lin a granola bar for the long wait.

s01951.summary: Courtier Isidore enters Armand's perfumery and exchanges cool greetings.
Armand offers a scent; Isidore names violet and cedar and something more.
Armand names bitter almond and Isidore's hand drifts to his coat.
Armand drinks the sample to show it is harmless.
Armand reveals the poisoned bottle is in Isidore's pocket.
Armand seizes his wrist and they struggle, smashing vials.
Isidore breaks free and runs as Armand sags, laughing quietly.

s01854.summary: Lawyers and client sit in a stuffy room before the judge.
Owen presses the clock; Leonor refuses to be rushed.
Desmond's request to speak causes a clash, but he only wants water.
Owen offers five years; Leonor rejects it for her client.
Leonor asks for privacy but neither lawyer moves.
Desmond insists he is innocent and the evidence is wrong.
Owen cites the strong file and his wife's testimony.
Leonor slides over a page from discovery that shakes Owen.
Leonor tells Desmond the find is very good.
Rattled, Owen asks for a minute; Leonor offers him nine.

s00861.summary: Evander pours wine for family game night at the lake cabin.
Beatrix leaves her topped-off glass untouched while Clarissa watches.
Clarissa accuses Hamid of cheating; Beatrix sides with him.
Beatrix tries to tell their father something; Clarissa keeps cutting her off.
Hamid quietly says to let her speak and the room stops.
Beatrix meets her father's eyes and reveals she sold the cabin.

s00219.summary: Roz holds Vinnie at gunpoint, demanding he open the safe fully.
Roz slams the safe open and grabs the lone sheet inside.
Vinnie grabs her wrist; they struggle and the gun shatters a clock.
Roz reads the paper: just a receipt for what she paid him.
She lowers the gun as the broken clock keeps ticking.

s00449.summary: Oswaldo stands over a gardener's body in the rooftop greenhouse.
The super says he found the body at half past five.
Oswaldo notes a clean trowel and soil packed under the nails.
He learns the roof door was unlocked and only two people have keys.
Eyes turn to Hyacinth, who claims she was asleep.
Oswaldo points out her muddy feet; pale mud streaks her soles.
Oswaldo sips coffee and lets the silence stretch.

s00842.summary: Hotel staff idle and work in the thundering sublevel laundry.
Tansy claims she got lost looking for the ice machine.
Reuben mentions the Hartley party thing; Sabine shuts him up.
Calloway approaches friendly and insists on escorting her up.
Tansy heads for the stairs and Sabine blocks her way.
Calloway recites her name and conference talk; she wants to leave.
They ask what she saw in the east elevator; she says nothing.
Calloway opens a washer revealing a lanyard matching hers.

s01948.summary: Josephine sets a demand paper before mill owner Cyrus.
Cyrus scoffs at striking; Josephine says they would strike over less.
She covers his ledger with her hand and holds firm as he rises.
Cyrus asks Constance if she signed; two hundred others did too.
Cyrus sags, drinks, and agrees to talk in the morning.
Josephine takes Constance's arm and they leave into the corridor.

s02230.summary: The crew works the casino vault in the cellar.
A woman in green who is not crew comes down the stairs.
Ferris draws on her; she says she killed the camera.
They question her; she is a cage cashier of eleven years.
She warns the owner arrives in four minutes; Ferris lowers the gun.
Nadia asks her name; she gives it as Imani.
The vault opens on stacked cash and the crew loads fast.
Footsteps above; old Kessler calls down for Imani.
Imani claims she is counting the reserve for an audit.
Ferris aims at the stairs; Imani stops his wrist, no guns.
Imani climbs and sweet-talks Kessler while the crew holds still.
Ferris waves the crew into the service tunnel with the bag.

s00699.summary: Brandt keeps the men down as enemy engines swell nearby.
Achterberg reports approaching armor and their guns dead.
Brandt steadies terrified Kowalski and tells him to run on his word.
A shell lands close and Brandt orders them to go.

s02312.summary: Rosaleen serves stew and urges reluctant Cillian to eat.
Thaddeus grumbles about overpriced service station sandwiches.
Rosaleen pushes stew on Yasmin, who politely resists.
Thaddeus probes Cillian's mood over the familiar stew.
Thaddeus accuses Cillian of selling the boat to a surveyor.
Cillian admits the mortgage is three months behind.
Thaddeus rejects the surveyor as help he does not need.
Thaddeus rises and goes up to the deck, leaving silence.
